label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 40
title: MVP: dashboard surfaces knowledge graph + agent memory as first-class views/management
body: Owner decision (P26 follow-up): knowledge graph and agent memory are BOTH in MVP - the dashboard must surface them (view/query/manage) rather than defer. Sources: core/phase3_advanced.py (knowledge_graph.json, semantic_cache.json), core/agent_memory.py + core/memory_api.py (agent memory stores). Extends BI-0015 (surface all 176 modules) and BI-0027 (E2E workflow views).
